merged.finding: AD-5 makes `SourceResult.ok` a bool, while the spec's SourceResult is ok, failed or partial. With a bool, a later-page failure after earlier pages succeeded has no defined outcome: AD-19 says a failed cycle never calls merge, so good pages are either discarded or merged as complete.

merged.reason: Contradicts the spec contract and leaves a coverage-honesty path undefined.
merged.fix: In AD-5 replace `ok` (bool) with a state of `OK`, `FAILED` or `PARTIAL` (adapter-contract.md:7); in AD-19 state that when page k>1 fails, merge is called with the pages read and `stopped_by_error`, coverage reads PARTIAL with the failure code, and unread rows stay `not reobserved`.

merged.finding: AD-6 says the cycle budget equals the 15 s interval with up to 5 sequential calls, but each call gets the full per-call timeout and no rule enforces the cycle deadline, so a cycle can run several times the budget; the `cycle overran (Ns)` strip has no matching SourceResult code.

merged.reason: The stated bound is not enforced by any rule, so the spec overrun behaviour (adapter-contract.md:26) is not guaranteed.
merged.fix: In AD-6 state that each call's timeout is min(per-call timeout, time left in the cycle budget); when the budget runs out the running call is killed and reaped, paging stops, coverage reads PARTIAL and the strip shows `cycle overran (Ns)`; add an `overrun` code to the AD-5 closed set.
